explanation:
Initially,

Charge on capacitor 10 μF

Q = CV = (10 μF) (50V)

Q = 500 μC

Final Charge on 10 μF capacitor

Q = CV = (10 μF) (20V)

Q = 200 μC

From charge conservation,

Charge on unknown capacitor

Q = 500 μC – 200 μC = 300 μC

Capacitance (C) = = = 15 F
